notes.title: Update #1 to Black Hole Hazard!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
We just posted Update #1 to Black Hole Hazard! Here are the highlights: 

[b]STORY MODE[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted difficulty level in  Chapter 5 
[*]Fixed the level design in the hard mode.
[/list]

[B]SURVIVAL MODE[/B]
[list]
[*]Added 5 maps and 3 items
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new features!
